summary: Mount Ord Lookout in Gila County, Arizona, is a 1983 102-foot lookout that replaced a 1936 Aermotor MC 39 tower, which was moved to the Rim Country Museum in Payson.

corrections.current: None relocated (The lookout was moved to the Rim Country Museum.)
corrections.proposed: Relocated: the 1936 Aermotor MC 39 tower, which the 1983 lookout replaced, was moved to the Rim Country Museum in Payson; date of move not found
corrections.why: NHLR says the tower that was moved is the 1936 tower the current lookout replaced, not the current lookout. The current lookout is listed as standing, and the museum piece has its own listing on firelookout.org.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR places the lookout in Gila County, Arizona. The Arizona fire-lookout listing gives Gila/Maricopa. The story gives the NHLR county and notes both.

notes_for_editor: The build dates (1936 original, 1983 replacement) and the 2002 registration come from the NHLR detail page only. Standing status comes from the firelookout.org listing. The date the 1936 tower reached the museum is unknown, so no relocation event is set (events need a year). The NHLR museum page URL the record links as '../us-az-mount-ord-at-rim-country-museum/' returned 404, and the Go-Arizona and Payson Roundup pages returned 403 and 429, so the museum's account (whole tower or only the top section) is unresolved. Search snippets (not used) mention a 2013 forum thread about decommissioning and a rotating camera; they were not verified on a fetched page. Access and staffing are unknown. Suggest checking with the Rim Country Museum (Payson) or the Tonto National Forest Mesa Ranger District before publishing a 'today' section.
